# Art briefs (generated by `pnpm artlist`: do not edit by hand)

Style for everything: dark-fantasy painterly illustration, bold readable silhouette, rich colour, soft rim light, no text, no border. Realm flavours are below each section. Card art is a **4:3 window** (about 1024x768); figures are **transparent PNG cut-outs**, feet on the bottom edge, about 1024 px tall.

## Riftwalkers (figures, `hero:<id>`)
